build_discrete_linear_system: build a discrete linear system F = C x + c from 1D FVM coefficients and cell variables
calculate_diffusion_terms: calculate diffusion terms for each channel using face diffusion coefficients and cell variables
calculate_convection_terms: calculate convection terms with configurable Dirichlet and Neumann boundary modes
add_implicit_source_terms: add implicit source terms to the diagonal of the block-tridiagonal matrix
add_explicit_source_terms: add explicit source terms to the forcing vector of the discrete system
